text:
maria: Heads-up: mkdocs build started failing after we moved the ops guide into a symlinked package. CI shows duplicate fragment IDs.

docs-bot: build failed: Duplicate ID found: 'getting-started' in 'site/guides/ops/setup.html' and 'site/guides/setup.html'

alex: Yep, symlinks can cause the same source rendered twice under different paths; slugify gives identical heading IDs.

ryan: Can you paste the mkdocs output and the affected file paths? Might be a slugify or plugin quirk.

maria: Error excerpt:
```
ERROR    -  Duplicate ID found: 'getting-started' in 'site/guides/ops/setup.html'
ERROR    -  Duplicate ID found: 'getting-started' in 'site/guides/setup.html'
```

susan: Options: 1) change url style (not ideal) 2) add frontmatter slug/permalink to the duplicate copy 3) stop using symlink and copy content.

alex: I prefer adding a small frontmatter slug on the symlinked copy, e.g., `slug: ops-setup`. Minimal and reversible.

maria: I opened PR #3321 with `slug: ops-setup` on the ops copy and fixed a stray code fence that lost indentation. Local build passes. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3321

docs-bot: preview build: https://deploy.preview/1746543210-3321 1 anchors unique, no duplicate-id warnings.

ryan: Can we add a CI guard to catch duplicate anchors early? A tiny script that runs `mkdocs build` and greps for "Duplicate ID" should fail fast.

susan: Yes. Add it as a separate job/step so it surfaces quickly and prints full paths for triage.

alex: I'll add `tools/docs/validate_anchors.py` to parse mkdocs output and exit non-zero when duplicates appear, then wire it into .github/workflows/docs.yml. Will keep it short.

maria: Also noted: during migration a fenced bash block lost leading spaces and rendered inline. I fixed it by using explicit triple backticks with `bash` in the PR.

ryan: Nice. Once CI guard is in place I'll run a few symlink variants locally and confirm.

alex: Pushed the script and workflow tweak as a follow-up commit; PR updated.

maria: Added a note in the migration guide about symlink caveats and anchor collisions so future moves check for this early.

alex: Merging now :shipit:

docs-bot: pull request merged by alex 1 commit abc123def (1746543234)

maria: Thanks all 1 I'll monitor the scheduled site build tomorrow for regressions. :+1:
